question: Should `ClawSegmentedControl` wrap every option set larger than four, or should wrapping be an explicit Skill Workshop/caller-level behavior?
rationale: Both approaches can fix the demonstrated truncation, but only an Android owner can establish whether the shared design-system contract should globally change for current and future callers.

options.title: Make wrapping opt-in
options.body: Keep the shared single-row default and enable balanced rows only for Skill Workshop or callers that explicitly request them.

options.title: Adopt global wrapping
options.body: Confirm that every current and future segmented control with more than four options should wrap, then audit sibling callers and add representative visual coverage.

recommendation.title: Make wrapping opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the shared single-row default and enable balanced rows only for Skill Workshop or callers that explicitly request them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android design-system merge history and explicit routing into this PR make joshavant the strongest available decision owner.
